concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-address-delete-node]] - Node.js customer-address deletion by customer ID plus address ID, including removal of that address from billing or shipping references on Vault payment methods and the not-found error route
warnings: Preserve the two-part customer-ID plus address-ID identity; do not describe the address ID as globally sufficient.
The stated effect removes the deleted address from referencing Vault payment methods; do not claim that it deletes the payment methods, customer, or subscriptions.
Keep address deletion separate from address creation and update, and treat the linked exceptions page as navigation only unless fully read.
